problem: External collars and ear tags are expensive, have short battery life and miss internal signals, so farmers detect disease and heat late.
business_model: Hardware implant plus ear tag plus subscription herd health software
product_category: Livestock biosensors and animal health AI

founders.name: Zarif Azher
education: Caltech, dropped out per company site
founders.background_notes: Previously built medical devices, biosensors and healthcare AI per the YC page.

founders.name: Kenneth Chan
founders.background_notes: Founders met as Caltech undergraduates. Other directories list further cofounders, which is unverified.

competitors.name: Halter
competitors.what: Solar powered smart collars for virtual fencing and cattle management

technical_complexity.rationale: A subcutaneous biosensor with temperature, heart rate and oxygen sensing and radio range needs biocompatibility, ultra low power design and manufacturing with a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware and a growing biometric dataset are hard to copy, but animal implants face approval and farmer adoption hurdles and funded collar makers were adjacent.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not public. Livestock tag and collar firms were consolidating (Merck bought Antelliq in an earlier deal) but nothing links them to Nexa.

market_need_then: Lux Research reported nearly 1B USD of venture funding in livestock health monitoring over five years, showing investor and farmer interest, and Nexa argued that collars do not suit beef cattle.

branding.domain_note: Uses nexa.farm, a .farm TLD, rather than nexa.com (website field).

identity.logo: Wordmark Nexa with registered trademark symbol
identity.visual_style: Agricultural meets science, numbered feature labels
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and simple farmer focused tagline Cattle health at your fingertips

branding.community_and_virality: Coverage in Farm Show and AgProud trade press in 2025, no evidence of community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press coverage exists but the name is shared with many other companies and no brand specific coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Nexa Labs joined YC in Summer 2025 with a hardware heavy pitch for implantable cattle sensors, ran California dairy pilots and announced initial deployments in November 2025. The YC directory lists it as acquired, but no acquirer or date was found and other YC pages still show it as active, so the outcome cannot be explained from public sources.
notes: Status conflict between YC pages (Acquired versus Active). About 500K pre-seed in Sept 2025 appears only on VCBacked, unverified. Co-founder list conflicts across directories. Competitor row is dated June 2025, shortly before the Summer 2025 batch; other collar and tag vendors found lacked dates. Exit type set to unknown by orchestrator: only the YC directory says Acquired, with no acquirer or date found.
